correctness.rationale: For simple cycles n>=3 reconstructed the weighted connected-partition recurrence using path sign-adjusted Narayana polynomials P=x(1+P)(1+tP). Cyclic compositions into k>=2 proper path blocks occur n/k times per marked composition, yielding C(x,t)=sum_{n>=2}c_n(t)x^n=P^2(1+t+tP)/(1-tP^2); n=2 is explicitly formal, not a simple cycle. With z=(1+t)x, u=t/(1+t)^2, T=(1+t)P, the last equation becomes T=z(1+T+uT^2), and (1+t)C=T^2(1+uT)/(1-uT^2). Coefficients [z^n u^j] count nonnegative plane unary–binary forests and Lagrange inversion gives the stated two multinomial sums. For 0<=j<=floor((n-1)/2), n>=3, the r=j or r=j-1 terms prove strictly positive integers, and u=0 gives gamma_n0=n-1. Independently enumerated actual cyclic connected partitions with a separate path recurrence and checked the recovered gamma polynomials n=3..9 against the algebraic formula; the proof by formal series is all-n.
